unit_rules.name: Inescapable Death
unit_rules.text: Once per Battle Round, one unit with this ability may use the Overwatch strategem, even if that Strategem has already been used this Battle Round. It costs 1 CP less. Additionally, while using the Overwatch strategem, unmodified Hit rolls of 2+ are successful.

unit_rules.name: Multi-Threat Eliminator
unit_rules.text: After an enemy unit Shoots a friendly +Ronnec+ unit within 3", this model can perform a Shoot action.
